'''Harris ''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] member of the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3631 BBY]] Harris and Doctor [[Narissa Delau]] were part of Lieutenant [[Talos Drellik]]'s [[Reclamation Service Yavin 4 expedition|expedition]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. Drellik eventually left to join the [[Eternal Alliance|Anti-Zakuul Alliance]], but remained in contact with the team. The team managed to uncover a set of Sith relics dated to the era of [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]]: a medallion, a coffer and a set of tablets. When Harris tried to sleep while wearing the medallion, the nightmares came almost instantly. Harris eventually uncovered a new artifact in the [[Architect's Hollow]], but when she brought the medallion and one of the tablets to it, a hulking [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] attacked the team, killing Harris and the escort and scattering the rest.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Harris appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' during Talos Drellik's Alliance Alert mission.<ref name="SWTOR" />
